title: Huge Lux Home Rooftop Views + Hot Tub, Pool+Sauna!
description:
Brand-new luxury home in Berry Hill! Less than 10 minutes to Broadway, this spacious retreat offers multiple bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and plenty of beds for large groups. Enjoy skyline views, a private hot tub, and modern open living. Guests also have access to shared amenities including a pool, sauna, firepit, and grill. Surrounded by top restaurants and recording studios, this home blends comfort, convenience, and Music City charm for an unforgettable stay.

The space
Traveling doesn't mean having to eat out for every meal. We supply all of the kitchen necessities so you are able to cook or reheat leftovers easily! 

- 4 bedrooms, multiple beds including king, queens, daybeds, sofa sleepers, and pullout queen chaise sleepers
- 4 bathrooms with modern fixtures
- Rooftop hot tub with skyline views
- Shared amenities including a pool, sauna, firepit, and grill.
- POOL is SEASONAL from April 1 - October 15
- Spacious open floor plan with tall ceilings and abundant natural light
- Fully equipped kitchen with pots, pans, storage containers, coffee maker, wine glasses, corkscrews, and more
- Large living area with flat‑screen TV
- Washer/dryer with detergent, towels, linens, hair dryer, iron & board
- WiFi, cable, and all essentials provided

This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1500 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $89 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $2 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional.

To make this process easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account - it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

If you have any questions, just message us anytime! Happy to help!

STRP#:2024-03-25-543

Guest access
Guests enjoy full access to the entire home, including bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, living spaces, and rooftop deck with hot tub. Two dedicated parking spaces plus shared parking available. Self‑check‑in with smart lock ensures a seamless arrival.
